document.name: Framework Relay authoritative logo geometry
document.authority: D-026 Evidence in Motion plus D-027 and CR-001; producer iteration 3 of 3
document.relationship: Retained Signal Ledger identity system with a reconciled Quiet Framework-derived logo.

rationale.quietFrameworkSource: Four open modular corner brackets retain governed modularity, restraint, and the founder-preferred framework logic.
rationale.signalLedgerIntegration: A non-diagonal stepped evidence relay moves through the open framework in discrete accountable increments, integrating structured trajectory without reusing the rejected Signal Ledger H-derived mark.
rationale.semanticMeaning: The frame sets reviewable boundaries; the relay shows movement through decision states; the square checkpoint identifies a current evidence point without claiming completion.
rationale.prohibitedInterpretation: The mark is not a shield, certification, platform product, building, client outcome, or legal/trademark conclusion.

clearspace.definition: One unit equals one 10-unit framework return; keep 20 master units clear on every side.

master.derivationRule: Primary, light, monochrome, reverse, and standard-mark SVGs use these coordinates without geometric deviation. Only the named 24-unit and 16-unit optical variants may deviate.

opticalVariants.purpose: 24–31 CSS px standalone mark with a whole-stroke modular frame and retained three-step relay.
opticalVariants.deviation: Frame returns and relay steps align to a 24-unit optical grid; the topology and square checkpoint remain.

opticalVariants.purpose: 16–23 CSS px browser chrome with whole-pixel bracket and relay strokes.
opticalVariants.deviation: The separate checkpoint is removed because the whole-pixel relay endpoint already identifies the current state at 16 CSS px.
